summary: Iteration 2 testing: Backend pytest now 41/41 (24 regression + 17 NEW admin CRUD) = 100%. All new admin endpoints (PUT/DELETE routes & students, GET/POST/DELETE /admin/users, GET /admin/revenue) and RBAC (403 for parent/driver) work as specified. Frontend: all 4 new admin screens (routes, students, drivers, bookings) load when reached via Account menu items, list seeded data correctly, show + Add button. Manage Routes create flow validated end-to-end (TEST_UI_Route3 created via UI -> appeared in list -> deleted via API). Back buttons return to /admin (Account screen) correctly. Regression: all 3 demo logins (admin/driver/parent) and Admin Overview still work. NOTE: After deploying new screen files Metro had to be restarted (sudo supervisorctl restart expo) because Fast Resolver / CI-mode bundle did not pick up the four new files automatically — until that restart, /admin/routes /admin/students /admin/drivers /admin/bookings all rendered the 'Unmatched Route' fallback. Worth flagging so user / main agent knows to restart Expo after adding new route files.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin CRUD additions are clean: proper require_roles('admin') guards, $inc for student_count maintenance on route changes, self-delete protection (400), duplicate-email guard (400), password_hash excluded from /admin/users via projection.
DELETE /api/routes/{id} correctly nullifies route_id on associated students via update_many — verified by test.
PUT /api/students/{id} correctly transfers student_count between old & new routes — verified by test.
GET /api/admin/revenue uses a clean aggregation pipeline (status=paid), returns total/count/pending/currency. Currency hardcoded 'GBP' is consistent with PRICE_MAP.
Frontend admin screens use testID consistently, expo-router router.push for nav, modal forms, and confirm() helper for delete on web — solid pattern.
Minor: _layout.tsx uses href:null for the 4 hidden screens; this only hides the tab, the routes are still reachable via router.push as proven by tests. OK.

rca_of_issue: Initial 'Unmatched Route' on /admin/{routes,students,drivers,bookings} was NOT a code bug — server.py and the new tsx files were correct. Root cause: Metro is started with CI=true (reloads disabled) so newly created files were not added to the bundle. Reproduction: add a new app/foo.tsx, browse to /foo → Unmatched Route. Mitigation: run 'sudo supervisorctl restart expo' (or remove CI=true to enable watch mode). After restart all 4 screens loaded, list/create flows worked, back navigation returned to /admin Account.
